The finite A4 full-premise witness is a synthetic branch; it is not a source-derived realization of the common physical tower. sm_coverage.policy: One row per entry of the canonical Standard Model term-and-sector inventory, classified by what OPH supplies. The inventory includes Lagrangian terms plus explicit sector and content stances that are required to interpret the action; it is not mislabeled as nineteen literal textbook terms.
